registered: 2026-10-14, before any real-data CK1-CK7 result of S or its combinations

S_main.note: z, Ea fixed at prior means; free log A_cal, log A_cyc, o45 (prior N(0,0.3^2), only in pair 0->1); MAP, Gaussian likelihood sigma_pair 0.20 Ah; integration origin = first operating row; horizon t*_k = CK_k + median visible (CK_j -> anchor j start) lag (3 d if none); base = Q_CK0 if the latest anchor is anchor 0 (mirrors M4/V2), else Q_fc,k-1 + eps; k = 1 uses prior means

G4_z1.note: linear law (D1/D2 analogue); calendar prior centre re-derived from Yagci at z=1 by the stage-2 fallback rule

G8_noprior.note: k = 1 still uses prior means (no data)

X_z05.note: classical sqrt-t calendar law, motivated by the stage-2 idle-gap diagnostic (D2.3); not in G-robust, never promoted

X_prior_only.note: no anchors used, to show how far the anchors move the model

combined.V2_Sfb: V2, except S_main where V2 returns branch 'fallback' (CK1-CK3)

gates.G-causal: exact-float identity under future noise and fit-on-CK1-prefix (candidate class only)
gates.G-proxy: MAE < V2 for every delta, MAX <= V2 MAX + 0.10 pp (real, main step, A4 2 Ah)
gates.G-epsfree: CK2-7 MAE at delta 0 <= V2 - 0.02 pp
gates.G-robust_S_main: variant groups G1..G8: a group wins if every setting in it beats V2's MAE (delta 0.4, real); pass if >= 6 of 8 groups win
gates.G-robust_combined: V2's six step variants, >= 5 of 6 wins (harness gates_vs_v2)
gates.G-pseudo: mean MAE over PG1, PG2, PC5, PC10 with k >= 3 (delta 0.4, main step) not worse than V2 by more than 0.02 pp
gates.G-regress: no checkup's absolute error grows by more than 0.30 pp vs V2 (delta 0.4)
gates.G-impl: numpy/pandas-only MyModel class within 0.001 pp, sample_data smoke test in Python 3.11

selection: No variant replaces S_main. Candidates are S_main, ENS50 and V2_Sfb. If more than one passes every performance gate, choose by the lowest G-pseudo mean MAE (pseudo scenarios only, k >= 3). Only the chosen model gets a candidate class.
order: run pseudo scenarios PG1/PG2 (k 4..7) and PC5/PC10 (k 3..7) and commit
run real scenario (all step variants) and PC5/PC10 k = 2 for reporting
